# docker_service_logs (Data Source)

Reads a snapshot of a swarm service's logs, aggregated over its tasks (`GET /services/{id}/logs`), like `docker service logs`. `log_entries` has one object per line (`timestamp`, `stream`, `source` = the service name, `message`, which alone is sensitive) and `logs` the same as text. `tail` (default 1000) and `since` bound what is read; the provider's host must be a swarm manager.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The last 100 lines of every task of the service, merged by time.
data "docker_service_logs" "web" {
  service_id = "web"
  tail       = 100
  since      = "30m"
}

output "web_errors" {
  value     = [for e in data.docker_service_logs.web.log_entries : e.message if e.stream == "stderr"]
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) Service ID, unique ID prefix or name.

### Optional

- `since` (String) Only lines at or after this time. Takes an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. `2026-01-02T15:04:05Z`) or a duration before now such as `42m` or `1h30m`, sent as the Engine's UNIX-timestamp `since`. Combined with `tail` when both are set.
- `tail` (Number) Lines to keep from the end of the logs of each container, service or task (the Engine's `tail`). Default `1000`, so state cannot grow without bound; `0` reads none, and there is no "all".

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of logs.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version of the daemon the provider talked to (GET /version Version).
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version the provider negotiated with the daemon (GET /version ApiVersion, capped by the client's max).
- `id` (String) Full ID the logs were read from.
- `log_entries` (Attributes List) One entry per log line in arrival order, read with timestamps=true and bounded by the tail/since inputs; `source` is the service name. Only `message` is sensitive (log lines can print secrets). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--log_entries))
- `logs` (String, Sensitive) The log entries as plain text, one line per entry: "<timestamp> <stream> <source> <message>". Sensitive: log lines can print secrets.

<a id="nestedatt--log_entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `log_entries`

Read-Only:

- `message` (String, Sensitive) Upstream `log line without the timestamp prefix and trailing newline`. Sensitive.
- `source` (String) Upstream `Spec.Name`.
- `stream` (String) Upstream `multiplexed frame header stream type: 1 = stdout, 2 = stderr; a TTY stream is not multiplexed (the Engine merges stdout and stderr at the source), so it is "combined"`.
- `timestamp` (String) Upstream `timestamps=true line prefix (RFC 3339 nano)`.
